description: A bunch of green grapes and two oranges sit on a flat, white surface against a dark blue background. One orange is partially peeled, revealing a pale yellow fruit. This orange sits on the right side of the image, while the other sits in the center and the grapes on the left. The entire composition is rendered in a loose, slightly abstract style with little detail.
title: Untitled (Grapes and Oranges)
